newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - April 29.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. FRATERNITE MATIN - Ivory Coast signs an offshore oil and gas deal with U.S.-based Sanata Fe Energy worth 75 billion CFA francs for developing block CI-202. - Wild-cat strikes hit Abidjan's widely used mini-bus services as drivers protest against government plans to make mandatory the fitting of speed limitation devices. - The mayor of Abidjan's run-down Treichville district airs ideas for an urban revival to draw in residents from faster developing districts; projects include crackdown on crime, a cultural centre, housing projects and development of lagoon frontages. A market destroyed by fire will be rebuilt. LE JOUR - Wave of strikes spreads; workers at state broadcaster RTI shut down radio and television programmes on Monday night with wild-cat strike over pay.
